{{Quote|The Jedi think of Ilum as their planet. Only two of them were here when we arrived, but they have ruins scattered around the place.|Grand Moff [[Ilyan Regus|Regus]]|<ref name="TOR-FS" />}}
The '''Northern Jedi ruins''' were located on the [[Eastern Ice Shelf]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]], remains of ancient [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] structure fallen into disuse by the time of the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR" />

==History==
{{Quote|The ruins housing Master Kaedan's base are too small for anything but a strike team. And they're surrounded by cliffs full of Duros shocktroopers.|Grand Moff Regus|<ref name="TOR-FS" />}}
During the Galactic War between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Jaric Kaedan|Kaedan]] and his [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Shock trooper/Legends|shock troopers]] held a base in the Northern Jedi ruins. The base was eventually stormed and Kaedan was killed by the [[Empire's Wrath]], [[Darth Nox]], [[Cipher Nine]], and the [[Hunter (individual)|Hunter]] as part of [[Battle of Ilum|Operation Dark Ice]].<ref name="TOR-FS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Northern Jedi ruins appear as an area on Ilum in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
